name: mcpserver-grok-plugin
description: Locate the local Grok CLI/TUI plugin workspace for McpServer TODO, session log, requirements, GraphRAG, and workspace continuity. This plugin is local-only until a GitHub repository is published.
parameterSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"localPath":{"type":"string","description":"Local path to the Grok plugin workspace; defaults to F:\\GitHub\\mcpserver-grok-plugin"}}}
commandTemplate: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $path='{{localPath}}'; if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($path)){ $path='F:\GitHub\mcpserver-grok-plugin' }; if(-not (Test-Path $path)){ throw ($path + ' not found') }; Get-Item $path | Select-Object FullName"
